content:
maria: FYI OrionBank sent back the SIG v6 — they want per-question evidence, with a short summary for each item. I'm compiling but need help on a few control areas. 

devin: On it. Which questions are blocking you? 

maria: Q12 (network segmentation) and Q23 (KMS/HSM). Also Q7 about third-party subprocessing — they want a list of vendor contracts + SOC2 dates. 

ashwin: I can take Q23. I'll attach the KMS design diagram and HSM attestation. Uploading now to the shared drive: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1ExampleLink

rachel: For Q7, we have the vendor list CSV and the latest SOC2 snapshots in /compliance/vendor-evidence/2025-09. I'll paste the filenames: 
```
vendor_list_2025-09.csv
soc2_snapshot_redwood_cloud_2024.pdf
procurement_vendor_matrix.xlsx
```

maria: Thanks. @janet_orion can you confirm whether OrionBank needs full contracts or redacted copies? They asked specifically about indemnity clauses. 

janet_orion: Redacted copies are fine, but we need the indemnity section visible. Also: can you confirm data residency for backups? 

devin: Backups: for hosted deployments we store backups in the same region by default; for Dedicated/Private we can configure region or on-prem. I'll add a short sentence for Q15. 

ashwin: KMS evidence uploaded: `kms-architecture.png`, `kms-rotation-policy.pdf`, `hsm-attestation-2025-06.pdf`. Link: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1ExampleLink/KMS 

maria: Great. For Q12 (network segmentation) we need a short conformance statement plus diagram. @devin can you export the infra diagram and call out the subnets used for inference vs control plane? 

devin: Pushing diagram now. Also including the security group rules snippet: 
```
ingress:
  - from: 10.0.0.0/16
  - ports: 443, 22
```

rachel: I'll attach a template answer for each SIG question so we keep language consistent. Uploading `sig_answer_template.md`. 

maria: Can someone also confirm retention windows for logs (Q31) and access review cadence (Q42)? Customer wants exact durations. 

ashwin: Logs retained 90 days by default for hosted; can be extended to 365 for enterprise plans. Access reviews: quarterly for privileged roles, annual org-wide. 

janet_orion: Perfect. One more: pricing — if we do a Dedicated POC for 3 months, any temporary discounts? 

maria: I'll follow up with sales ops on the discounting, posting in a separate thread. 

sig-assistant: Reminder: please attach evidence files to the SIG tracker ticket (#SIG-ORION-122) or the drive link above. Missing items: contract redactions, infra diagram final, SOC2 PDF. 

maria: Plan: i) devin finalizes network diagram and SG snippet by EOD; ii) ashwin confirms KMS docs uploaded (done); iii) rachel formats answers and uploads template (in progress); iv) I will assemble and submit to Orion by tomorrow noon. 

devin: Diagram uploaded: https://drive.google.com/file/d/diagram123, filename `orion_network_segmentation_v2.svg` 

rachel: Template uploaded and filled for Q7, Q12, Q15, Q23, Q31, Q42. Link: https://drive.google.com/drive/folder/template123 

maria: Thanks team :tada: I'll ping @janet_orion when we submit. 

janet_orion: Appreciate the quick turnaround, team. 

maria: Submitted to Orion security via the tracker — ticket #SIG-ORION-122 updated with attachments. 

sig-assistant: Ticket status: submitted -> awaiting customer review. 

maria: Closing this thread, follow-ups on pricing in #sales-pricing. :lock:
